name: claude
doc: Claude Code on a Claude plan. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR selects another login (another account and quota): standard homes ~/.claude, ~/.claude-b, ~/.claude-c. Shares the coordinator's quota when the coordinator is Claude Code on the same account.

list_models.note: no CLI listing: run-model discover generates the next version ids of each family (claude-sonnet-5-5 -> 6-0, 6, 5-6) and switches to the newest that answers a smoke test

coordinator_env_doc: variables this CLI sets in the processes it starts: when one is set, the coordinator session runs on this CLI, on the account its account_env names in this process (unset = default home). AUTOPILOT_COORDINATOR=<cli>[/<account>] overrides.
